newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Crown down as Packer shares placed.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Crown down as Packer shares placed.

text.p: Shares in casino operator Crown Ltd were over five percent lower in early trading on Wednesday as brokers BZW placed on the market the 75 million Crown shares that Australia's richest man, Kerry Packer, sold on Tuesday.
At 11.30 p.m. (0130 GMT), Crown was 17 cents or 5.65 percent down at A$2.84 on a turnover of 9.15 million shares.
Most of the shares traded before the market opened, with the buying in Crown coming from overseas, brokers said.
Packer's Consolidated Press Holdings Ltd (CPH) said on Tuesday it had sold the Crown shares at A$2.72 each. CPH said it would retain the remaining 47.4 million shares it owns in Crown.
